the asymptotic relative efficiency is maximized when equally-spaced sample quantiles are used, and the ABLUEs of both the location and scale parameter are asymptotically efficient.

the ABLUE of the location parameter is given by the sample median, and that the ABLUEs of the scale parameter are given by linear combinations of the sample quantiles, with the coefficients of the extreme observations being small and those of the observations close to the median being large.
